## Follow-up review

**Verdict:** Prior `total()` None/empty guard is fixed; `first_name()` empty-name crash remains open.

### Prior findings

1. **`5d977ce4424f3a31` (resolved)** — `total()` now short-circuits with `if not items: return 0`, which covers both `[]` and `None` before the generator expression runs.

2. **`09584834c0aebae2` (open)** — `first_name()` is still `user.name.split()[0]`. An empty or whitespace-only `name` yields `[]`, so `[0]` raises `IndexError`. No guard was added in this commit.

No new findings on the diff beyond the still-open prior item.

**Recommendation:** request-changes
